The M15 RSI at 69.3 shows strong bullish momentum, indicating that any dip into the 61.8% level will be rapidly bought up, preventing a deeper trend reversal.

Confluence 5: Integration of Standard Deviation (SD), Fibonacci Circles, and CRT (Candle Range Theory) validated by Volatility Indicators (Bollinger Bands contracting on M15). Under Candle Range Theory, the current session is in a retracement phase within a larger bullish expansion. The -1.5 to -2 Standard Deviation band of the contracting M15 Bollinger Bands converges with the Fibonacci Circle golden ratio expansion at 81125.00, defining the exact mathematical boundary of the defensive staff where price volatility is expected to exhaust and reject.
